name: AM2R

original.title: Metroid II: Return of Samus (AM2R fan remake)

assets.needs: Original AM2R 1.1 (AM2R_11.zip), patched into an Android APK on a PC with AM2RLauncher or with AM2R-Autopatcher-Android. The resulting APK contains the whole game (assets/game.droid), so nothing is read from storage at run time.
assets.location: Inside the installed APK (assets/game.droid, music .ogg, lang/*.ini).
assets.notes: The game data string in game.droid reads 'V1.5.5' (Community Updates 1.5.5); the APK versionName 1.5.3 comes from the wrapper template. The patched APK installs with the system package installer.

settings.in_app_menu: Title screen or pause > Options: Display, Sound, Controls, Joypad, Extras, Gameplay.
settings.summary: config.ini is a GameMaker ini (values written as quoted reals, e.g. Widescreen="1.000000"). Display: Widescreen, Scale, VSync, HUD/map/hints, Metroid counter. Controls: aiming style, missile toggle/hold, classic morph ball, spiderball style, auto-climb, auto-morph, analog walking, touch control scale, joystick/XInput button ids. Extras: Fusion suit style, early baby Metroid, extreme lab Metroids, IGT display, low health alarm, controller button prompts. Gameplay: Insanity mode.

controls: GameMaker joystick and XInput-style pad mappings in [Control] (EnableXBJoypad, EnableJoystick). Android touch controls scale TouchScale (1-8, shown in the menu as 9-value). Controller button tips: Controller=0 is XBox. Not tested on the Thor.
display: Single screen. Widescreen=1 gives a 16:9 view (needs a room transition to apply). Old GameMaker runner (target SDK 23, armeabi-v7a only), so it runs as a 32-bit app.
saves: /data/data/com.companyname.AM2RWrapper/files/save1 (also save2, save3 when used). Root needed; files are mode 600 owned by the app uid.
notes: Package com.companyname.AM2RWrapper is the AM2RLauncher/Autopatcher Android wrapper template. AM2R-Community-Updates publishes source only (no GitHub releases); updates come by re-patching with AM2RLauncher's 'Community Updates (Latest)' profile and reinstalling.
verified: Device: version, install time and installer, config.ini and save file. APK: contents, options.ini, game.droid strings (V1.5.5, config.ini, save names). Source: scripts/load_gameoptions.gml and objects/oOptions*.object.gmx from AM2R-Community-Updates (HEAD, not tag-matched to 1.5.5), labels from the APK's lang/english.ini.
